images.name: NOE VALLEY
images.brief: A compact friendly Noe Valley neighborhood: walkable attached colorful Edwardian and Victorian homes, a small independent bookstore, bakery, neighborhood grocery, modest cafe, a pocket playground and little free library. Sage, cream, butter yellow, dusty blue and coral colors with coherent stone foundations and stoops. Connected streets wrap around a small planted neighborhood square and a quiet pedestrian lane; hills appear as stepped sidewalk grades and stairs. Mature deciduous trees, stroller-friendly clear gray sidewalks, park benches, planted front setbacks and bicycle racks. An original open-source-themed startup gym can be a welcoming co-op workshop beside the bookshop. Distinct intimate domestic scale, not Marina nightlife or downtown towers.
